author_overlap.definition: An included study has at least one author who is the same person as a manuscript author; exact-name candidates are identity-adjudicated.

limitations: The repository lacks per-study inclusion dates, so historical publication status is not reconstructed.
S074 has a plausible 2025 formal successor, but the version relation requires author confirmation.
The broad-heading automation table is an existence crosswalk, not an exhaustive method-by-subtype matrix.
Peer-reviewed-only results filter included-copy coding by current study status; they are not a complete re-extraction from every version of record.
